Hi Alice — thanks for laying out the asks. Short answers up front and then the supporting details below: 

- Region pin: Your tenant is explicitly pinned to eu-west-1 (Ireland) with host-level affinity; we do not replicate primary data outside that region by default.
- Snapshot/backups: Ephemeral snapshots are short-lived (default 7 days) unless you opt into longer archival; we disable cross-region replication for NovaCorp.
- Evidence: We can provide a purge manifest (CSV), an immutable snapshot purge log with timestamps, and an HMAC SHA256 digest signed by our ops key. Delivery: we can deliver initial artifacts within 48 hours.

Details / how this works (ops runbook summary):
- Tenant pinning: When the Dedicated tenant is provisioned we set a geofence policy in the orchestration layer. That policy enforces scheduling and storage attachment only to eu-west-1 resource pools. The policy is recorded in the provisioning metadata and in our audit log streams.
- Snapshot lifecycle: Snapshots taken by the serving runtime are categorized as:
  * Ephemeral: checkpointing for warm starts and autoscaling (default TTL = 7d). No cross-region replication.
  * Retained (optional): explicit export to long-term storage (S3) when you request archival.
- Purge workflow: On a tenant deletion or manual purge request we run the Purge Job that:
  1) enumerates all object IDs (snapshots, KV caches, temporary volumes) for the tenant,
  2) verifies current storage locations (bucket/pool) are eu-west-1,
  3) deletes objects,
  4) writes a purge manifest,
  5) computes an HMAC SHA256 over the manifest and logs, and
  6) stores the signed digest in our immutable audit stream (append-only).
- Keys & signing: We use a tenant-segmented KEK (customer-key-encrypted-key) that is rotated quarterly. Signed HMACs are produced by a dedicated ops signing key; copies of the signing public key and rotation records can be provided under NDA.

Attachments I've included for reference: novacorp-tenant-geolock-matrix.csv (shows the explicit allocation), ephemeral-snapshot-purge-log-20261205.txt (sample), kek-rotation-summary.pdf (high-level).

Hannah and Jordan — can you confirm we can produce the signed digest for NovaCorp within 48 hours and whether Legal needs any specific format (GPG signature, DocuSign attestation, etc.)?

Best,
Dylan

+1 on the 48h delivery. Ops runbook notes / internal checklist for producing evidence:

- Generate purge manifest CSV (object id, storage path, delete timestamp, operator id).
- Produce purge log (system.log rotation) and capture S3 (eu-west-1) delete markers.
- Compute HMAC SHA256 over the manifest; use ops-signing-key-v3.
- Provide public key fingerprint and rotation history (kek-rotation-summary.pdf attached).
- If Legal requires, we can also GPG-sign the manifest with our signing key and include the pubkey.
- For additional assurance, we can provide a signed statement confirming no cross-region replication flags were set for this tenant.

Jordan: please schedule the purge-simulation job against the NovaCorp tenant snapshot set and collect the artifacts into a runbook bundle (drive link above). Aim to stamp and sign by EOD tomorrow.

Small internal note: watch for legal hold — if Legal requests preservation we will not purge until we receive explicit release. Otherwise we proceed as requested.

Thanks — Hannah

1) Preferred evidence format: PDF manifest + HMAC digest, plus the public key fingerprint. GPG is nice-to-have but not required.
2) Delivery: 48 hours is fine. Can you include a short one-paragraph attestation on Redwood letterhead stating that NovaCorp data was never replicated outside eu-west-1 for the lifetime of the tenant?

If you can send the artifacts and the attestation to legal@datacorp.com and cc me, I'll route it into procurement. If there's anything blocking (legal hold, pending export requests), flag immediately.
